# Book_03 — Discovery: The Authentication Audit
:::

::: {.callout-note}
Where Book 02 measured the estate to decide what survives, this book measures the **authentication posture** of what remains. Spec3-D1.8 is the instrument, the Arc-eligibility classification is its most consequential output, and the CCM-BIR record — not a spreadsheet — is its deliverable. (Spec3-D1.8, ADR-068 Phase A)
:::
